# Baselane

> > Baselane is an all-in-one banking, accounting, and rent collection platform designed specifically for landlords and real estate investors.

Baselane provides integrated financial services for rental property owners, combining FDIC-insured banking through Thread Bank, automated bookkeeping with Schedule E tax reporting, and rent collection tools. The platform serves landlords across long-term rentals, short-term rentals, and multi-property portfolios.

## Key Topics

- Landlord banking
- Rent collection
- Property accounting
- Tax preparation
- Real estate investors
- FDIC-insured accounts
- Schedule E reporting
- ACH payments
- Bookkeeping automation
- Multi-property management
- Short-term rentals
- Long-term rentals
- Payment automation
- 1099 tax forms
- Tenant screening

## Core Products

- [Baselane: Landlord Software - Banking, Accounting & Rent Collection](https://www.baselane.com): Baselane homepage: all-in-one banking, accounting, and rent collection for landlords
- [Banking Accounts For Real Estate Investors | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/landlord-banking): Baselane banking for real estate investors with FDIC-insured accounts and automation
- [Rental Property Bookkeeping Software for Landlords | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/landlord-accounting): Automated accounting software for rental property bookkeeping and Schedule E reporting
- [Online Rent Collection For Real Estate Investors | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/rent-collection): Automated online rent collection with ACH payments and tenant portal integration
- [Tax Preparation Software for Real Estate Investors | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/tax-preparation): Tax software generating Schedule E, 1099s, and auto-categorized deductions for landlords
- [High-Yield Landlord Savings Account 2026 | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/landlord-banking-apy): High-yield savings account for landlords with APY on rent and reserves

## Property Types & Use Cases

- [Banking & Bookkeeping for Landlords | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/long-term-rentals): Banking and bookkeeping for long-term rental owners with automated rent collection
- [Short-Term Rental Banking & Bookkeeping | Baselane](https://baselane.com/short-term-rentals): Banking and bookkeeping for short-term rentals with Airbnb integration and categorization
- [Banking & Bookkeeping for Multi-Property Investors | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/multi-property-investors): Scalable banking and bookkeeping for multi-property rental portfolios with tax prep

## Additional Financial Services

- [Security Deposit Account for Landlords | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/security-deposit-account): Landlord security deposit accounts with no fees and APY earnings
- [Rental Property Loans and Financing | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/rental-property-loans): Rental property loan marketplace with DSCR, HELOC, and conventional loan options
- [Rental Property Insurance | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/landlord-insurance): Landlord insurance quotes through Obie partner with affordable rental property coverage
- [Free Tenant Screening Service for Landlords | Baselane](https://www.baselane.com/tenant-management/tenant-screening-service): Free tenant screening with Equifax reports including background and eviction history
